questions.stem: Article 32 of the Constitution of India is associated with:
questions.explain: Article 32 gives the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of fundamental rights.

questions.stem: Who is the ex-officio Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explain: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.stem: The Dandi March led by Mahatma Gandhi began in which year?
questions.explain: The Salt March from Sabarmati to Dandi began in March 1930.

questions.stem: The Tropic of Cancer does not pass through which of these states?
questions.explain: The Tropic of Cancer crosses several central and eastern states, not Kerala in the far south.

questions.stem: The Reserve Bank of India’s repo rate is best described as:
choices: The rate at which banks lend to each other overnight
The rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks against securities
The interest paid on savings accounts
questions.explain: Repo is the policy rate at which the RBI injects short-term liquidity against collateral.

questions.stem: A Ramsar site is designated primarily for the conservation of:
questions.explain: The Ramsar Convention is an international treaty on wetlands of international importance.

questions.stem: Which gas is released as a by-product of photosynthesis in green plants?
questions.explain: Water is split during the light reactions and oxygen is released.

questions.stem: Fundamental Duties were inserted into the Constitution by which amendment?
questions.explain: The 42nd Amendment, 1976, added Part IVA (Article 51A) on Fundamental Duties.

questions.stem: The southwest monsoon that brings most of India’s summer rain is driven mainly by:
choices: Seasonal reversal of winds due to differential heating of land and sea
Tides in the Bay of Bengal
questions.explain: Land heats faster than the ocean, drawing moisture-laden winds from the sea; ENSO can modulate, not replace, this pattern.

questions.stem: The FRBM Act is primarily intended to:
choices: Fix the repo rate each quarter
Set a statutory framework for fiscal deficit discipline
questions.explain: The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act aims to institutionalise fiscal discipline and deficit targets.
